body: Founder: 'add towers around the nodes so beginning of game is a little slower.' One neutral ArenaTower per node, blocks arena_tick_nodes' capture channel until destroyed. Team-mode only, wired via explicit arena_towers_reset() at the server's real match-start call site (not the shared arena_init_teams() ~300 tests call directly) so no existing test behavior changed. Wire-synced + rendered client-side. 4 new tests, full suite green (690 assertions), build clean, test_10_bots.sh unaffected.
title: Node towers: gate node capture behind a destroyable tower per node
